output.headline: Technology-focused sponsor with an open platform in the target's sub-sector; returns clear the 20% target at the ask, with a maximum price of $356M.
output.differentiator: Closes 86% of its deals, ahead of TPG Capital and Warburg Pincus, and has more than $75 billion raised. Its sub-sector record is thinner than most peers'.
output.why_them: Add-on to open Health IT platform; returns clear at asking price

acquirer_overview.title: A large technology-focused sponsor that closes most of what it starts
points: Financial sponsor with 14 deals from 2017 to 2023; 12 closed (86%), all control deals [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Describes itself as "One of the largest and most active technology-focused private equity firms in the world"; more than $75 billion raised, undated [P:1, P:2].
Median deal is $192M, and 6 of 14 deals fall in the $150M-$600M band around the target's $300M [T:record, K:size_band].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform in the target's sub-sector
points: An open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on rather than a new bet; size fit is the second named angle [A:angles].
High Growth is a motive in 6 of 14 deals, matching the target's 20.0% growth [M:high_growth].

Slight factors for: has bought from this kind of seller, deal not smaller than usual, deal count. Share of deals in the sub-sector is a slight factor against [S:own_fit_s, S:not_smaller, S:activity, S:sector_share].

precedent_activity.title: One deal in the target's sub-sector, larger precedents in neighbouring sectors
points: Hudson Care Analytics: $16M management buyout, 2020, 18.9x, closed. It is the only Health IT deal [D:MA-2020-0260, T:record].
Prime Medical Technologies (devices): $446M leveraged buyout, 2021, 15.3x, closed [D:MA-2021-0297].
Pacific Biopharma (pharma): $724M merger of equals, 2021, 23.6x, closed. Shows it will pay a high multiple for growth [D:MA-2021-0465].

valuation_context.title: The median anchor is defensible and the return clears at the ask
points: 13 same-sub-sector comparables show 19.4x to 23.3x, median 21.4x. The target's 25.0% margin beats the comps' 22.2% median but is not top quartile, so the 50th percentile anchors [V:comps].
Its own median paid is 16.2x, below the comps' lower quartile of 19.4x. It has paid 20.6x for Highland Instruments and 23.6x for Pacific Biopharma [V:comps, D:MA-2020-0151, D:MA-2021-0465].
At 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $239M and IRR at the ask is 25.3% against a 20% target. Maximum price is $356M [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Thin sub-sector record
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 of 14 deals is in Health IT; 13 are outside it [T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: An open platform in the sub-sector gives an add-on route [A:angles].
risk_flags.reality: Conviction is Medium, not High, because the sub-sector record is neutral [C:conviction].

risk_flags.title: Price discipline
risk_flags.concern: Its median paid of 16.2x sits below the comps' 19.4x lower quartile [V:comps].
risk_flags.mitigant: It paid 23.6x, 21.1x and 20.6x in 2020-2022 neighbouring-sector deals [D:MA-2021-0465, D:MA-2022-0398, D:MA-2020-0151].
risk_flags.reality: Expect pushback below the 21.4x median; the 25.3% IRR at the ask leaves room to bid [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Equity capacity unconfirmed
risk_flags.concern: Fund size was not researched, so equity capacity is unconfirmed [R:FUND_SIZE_UNKNOWN].
risk_flags.reality: The deal needs a $239M equity cheque; confirm fund headroom before the call [V:lbo].

conviction.rationale: Medium: one deal in the target's own sub-sector is neutral, while the open platform add-on route counts in its favour. Returns clear the target at the ask [C:conviction, T:record, A:angles, V:lbo].
